name: Yashwantrao Chavan Mumbai–Pune Expressway
history: India's first six-lane, fully access-controlled concrete expressway, built by the Maharashtra State Road Development Corporation. It climbs the Western Ghats through the scenic Khandala–Lonavala section and cut the Mumbai–Pune journey from four or five hours to about two. A 'Missing Link' project with long tunnels is being built to bypass the congested ghat stretch and shorten the route further.
facts: India's first fully access-controlled expressway, fully opened in 2002.
Crosses the Western Ghats through the Bhor Ghat near Khandala.
The under-construction 'Missing Link' includes some of India's widest road tunnels.
